reference.pathophysiology: RB1 loss unleashes cone precursor proliferation seeding vitreous and subretinal space while melanocytic GNAQ clones expand through Bruch weak points; metastatic emboli lodge in fenestrated choroid bilaterally and lymphoma homing crosses blood retinal barrier with CNS tropism.
